oracleDigestNote: Self-consistency and reading notes (deliverable-required field of this coordinator record). (1) oracleDigest is the detached IA-2.8 document digest: sha256 over the canonical {domain: 'foreman-line.u1.expected-outcomes', apiVersion: '0.1.0', payload} wrapper where payload is THIS document with the oracleDigest field omitted entirely; it is never computed over the stored bytes and never self-referential (A-U1.8.01 digest classes). (2) The promotion request binds this record: request.oracleDigest equals this oracleDigest value, and the request's own detached IA-2.2 requestDigest covers that binding. The verifier fetches this file at the pinned commit by API-by-SHA, recomputes oracleDigest, and refuses on any mismatch (INVALID/U1_ARTIFACT_INVALID). (3) expectedExitStatus is the DIRECT exit status of the exercised control surface (coordinator authority from the PIN-03 control definitions): a demonstrated refusal or rejection carries 1, an unrefused execution (landed effect or allow path) carries 0, and NC-U1-12 (the positive control) carries 0 per A-U1.8.04. (4) expectedRefusalClassId is exactly one IA-6 id or the literal 'none'; 'none' means the control demonstrates no IA-6 refusal class (its refusal is a decision-level IA-7 condition, named in requiredSignals). NC-U1-02 spans several classes; STATE_REVISION_STALE is the required representative and requiredSignals names the other demonstrations. (5) expectedClassification is the T4 derivation the row's observed signals must yield (refusal+no-effect = mechanical; no-refusal+effect+detection = detected; no-refusal+effect+no-detection = unsupported). NC-U1-12 is the one non-mutation control (PIN-03 #12): its derivation is acceptDemonstrated with exitStatus 0 -> mechanical. (6) permittedGaps is exactly the three named PIN-09 inherited gaps (7.6): no other not-exercised/gap row is admitted anywhere. (7) promotionRequestId binds this record to the first promotion request: that request MUST use promotionRequestId 'fk-p18-prime-r1' (closed grammar [a-z0-9-]{1,64}); any other request re-authors this record under its own id as a recorded coordinator act. (8) The byte digest of these committed bytes is recorded separately where byte class is cited (pin record, inventory entries); it is never compared to oracleDigest.
